target_customer: Commercial, industrial, municipal and multifamily property owners with high energy bills (data centers, grocery stores, offices, warehouses, hospitals)
problem: Businesses want lower energy bills and backup power from solar and batteries but face large upfront capital costs and complex installation.
business_model: Energy storage and solar as a service: Vista designs, finances, installs and operates systems at no upfront cost and earns from customer savings
product_category: Commercial solar plus battery storage as a service

founders.name: Maxim Kraft
previous_startups: Tour (software startup co-founded in high school, acquired)
founders.background_notes: From the YC company page and the Vista Space YC launch post

founders.name: Petar Matejic
founders.background_notes: Co-founded the UNLV student satellite team per the launch post; education not stated

founders.name: Chaitanya Kore
founders.background_notes: Founded the Space Force Association Great Lakes chapter and helped secure a battery gigafactory in Illinois per the launch post

technical_complexity.rationale: As Vista Space the team built a structural battery module for spacecraft, a hardware problem. The current energy as a service model is standard engineering plus project finance and installation logistics, with hardware sourced from third parties.

defensibility.rationale: Long contracts with customers create some lock-in, but the model of zero upfront storage and solar was already offered by others and installers are numerous.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large players offered no-capex storage models (ABB announced a subscription model in May 2025). No acquisition or copying of Vista itself was found.

market_need_then: Commercial customers face demand charges and resilience needs, and zero capex storage as a service had been marketed for years (Stem announced a no money down model earlier, date not shown in the snippet). The pitch of $0 upfront and up to 30% bill savings addresses the capital barrier.

branding.domain_note: Uses vistapower.com. Legal entity on the site is Vista Space Inc.

rebrands.why: Not stated in sources. The company moved from spacecraft structural batteries to commercial energy storage and solar. Exact date not given.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found. The name is generic and shared with other energy firms such as Vistra and an unrelated grid software company called Vista Power.

pivots.from: Structural batteries for spacecraft (Vista Space, Voltaris 1)
pivots.to: Zero upfront commercial solar and storage (Vista Power)
pivots.why: Not stated in sources. Exact date not given.

outcome_analysis: Vista Power is active and early. It started as Vista Space, selling structural battery modules to satellite makers, and by the Winter 2024 batch it described itself as a zero upfront solar and storage provider for commercial buildings. No public funding beyond aggregator listings was found and no outcome news exists, so the story is too early to attribute to specific success or failure factors.
notes: Funding seen only on aggregators and unverified: about $983K pre-seed in April 2024 with Y Combinator, TwentyTwo VC and 10 BOND (VCBacked), and another listing says $2M seed. These are not recorded as rounds. No dated competitor sources near the batch were found. A search for outcome news returned only unrelated companies. Another company called Vista Power (AI grid dispatch) is unrelated.
